zh-CN.title: 花间来日 · 纸间花笺
items: 保留生日欢迎，将油画花园、奶油纸面与缎带统一用于普通弹窗、面板、抽屉和按钮
重新整理聊天、通讯与菜单的生日外观，适配手机、桌面与深色模式
生日概览、设置与生日信分层展示，手机标题栏恢复滚动后的通栏背景
修复花卉贴图边缘断线，生日导航与输入区兼容已选背景和气泡
聊天顶栏、输入区与常用面板补充蜡烛和礼物细节

en.title: A garden of tomorrows · Painted stationery
items: Preserved the welcome and brought its painted garden, cream paper and ribbons to ordinary dialogs, sheets, drawers and buttons
Refined birthday styling across Chats, Contacts and Menu for mobile, desktop and dark mode
Separated birthday overview, date settings and letters, with full-width mobile headers appearing on scroll
Removed hard artwork edges and kept birthday navigation and input styling alongside selected backgrounds and bubbles
Added candle and gift details to chat headers, input edges and common panels
